fixes.explanation: Yes, baker. Isaiah says, "Aram from the east and Philistia from the west have devoured Israel with open mouths." That's one nation on each side, and Philistia is the one on the west. So Philistia is your answer. I think this is a heavy picture, and Isaiah gives it to us plainly.

Yes, friend. Isaiah says, "Manasseh devours Ephraim, and Ephraim Manasseh; together they turn against Judah." Judah is the one they turn against together. So Judah is your answer. It's a rough picture, and Isaiah doesn't soften it.
